LanguageData.MF_PreparationNoRoom: Not enough space. Change the direction or guest list.
LanguageData.MF_BabyCarryHelp: The caregiver carries the baby to the photo spot. The photo is taken automatically once everyone arrives. After the photo or cancellation, the caregiver returns the baby to a bed or safe place.
LanguageData.MF_BabyHereHelp: The baby stays here, and the selected guests gather nearby.
LanguageData.MF_BirthdayAtBedHelp: A subject unable to walk stays here. Sleeping guests are woken when called, and a caregiver can carry a baby to the photo spot.
LanguageData.MF_BabyNoGuardian: No adult can carry the baby right now. Choose another caregiver or take the photo here.
LanguageData.MF_BabyUnsafePlace: This spot is too cold or too hot for the baby. Choose a photo spot with a comfortable temperature.
LanguageData.MF_PreparationReady: The photo is taken automatically once everyone arrives. Sleeping guests are woken when called.
LanguageData.MF_PreparationGuardianProblem: {0}: Cannot carry the baby right now. Choose another caregiver.
LanguageData.MF_PreparationPawnProblem: {0}: {1}. Adjust the guest list or wait until they are available.
LanguageData.MF_PreparationCannotReach: {0}: Cannot reach their assigned photo position. Clear the route or choose another location.
LanguageData.MF_PreparationSpaceProblem: {0} attending / {1} standing spaces ({2} needed). Change the guests, direction or location.
LanguageData.MF_PreparationNotEditing: This gathering is already taking a photo or has ended. Close this window and check again.
LanguageData.MF_PreparationRandomHelp: The count includes the birthday person and any required caregiver. Only available guests are drawn. You can adjust the selection afterwards.
